name: kslides
description: kslides is a Kotlin DSL wrapper for reveal.js. It is meant for people who would prefer to build presentations with IntelliJ than Powerpoint.

paragraphs: kslides is a Kotlin DSL for the awesome reveal.js presentation framework. It is meant for people who prefer working with an IDE rather than PowerPoint. It works particularly well for presentations with code snippets and HTML animations. Slides are authored in Markdown, HTML, or the Kotlin HTML DSL.
This presentation is served statically from Netlify and GitHub Pages. kslides content can also run dynamically on Heroku.
Documentation lives at the Zensical docs site, with the API reference generated by Dokka.
